<!doctype html><html><head><meta charset=utf8><meta name=viewport content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><style>:root{color-scheme:light;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}body{margin:0;padding:0;font:14px -apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,sans-serif;background:#fff;color:#000}img{max-width:100%}[hidden]:not([hidden=until-found i]){display:none!important}</style></head><body>
<title>E-Portfolio ธนพิพัฒน์</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Prompt:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* เลย์เอาต์: Hero → ประวัติ → เป้าหมาย → การศึกษา → กิจกรรม → ติดต่อ → Thank You
   เมนูสไลด์จากขวาบนมือถือ เมนูแนวนอนบนจอ ≥900px  ธีมแดง แก้สีที่ :root */
:root {
  --bg: #ffffff;
  --bg-tint: #fff1f0;
  --surface: #ffffff;
  --text: #2a2527;
  --muted: #6b6266;
  --line: #ecdcdb;
  --accent: #D62828;
  --accent-dark: #9D0208;
  --accent-text: #C41F1F;
  --heading: #9D0208;
  --accent-soft: #FFE5E5;
  --accent-soft-2: #ffc9c9;
  --hero-a: #D62828;
  --hero-b: #9D0208;
  --shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(157, 2, 8, 0.12);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 28px rgba(157, 2, 8, 0.2);
  --font: 'Prompt', 'Noto Sans Thai', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  --radius: 16px;
  --header-h: 64px;
  --ease: 0.3s ease;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
  :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
    --bg: #160f0f;
    --bg-tint: #1f1514;
    --surface: #251918;
    --text: #f4e8e7;
    --muted: #b9a9a7;
    --line: #3a2827;
    --accent-dark: #ff6b6b;
    --accent-text: #ff7b7b;
    --heading: #ff8f8f;
    --accent-soft: #3a1b1b;
    --accent-soft-2: #4d2222;
    --hero-a: #C42222;
    --hero-b: #7d0409;
    --shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
    --shadow-lg: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
    color-scheme: dark;
  }
}
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: #160f0f;
  --bg-tint: #1f1514;
  --surface: #251918;
  --text: #f4e8e7;
  --muted: #b9a9a7;
  --line: #3a2827;
  --accent-dark: #ff6b6b;
  --accent-text: #ff7b7b;
  --heading: #ff8f8f;
  --accent-soft: #3a1b1b;
  --accent-soft-2: #4d2222;
  --hero-a: #C42222;
  --hero-b: #7d0409;
  --shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 28px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  color-scheme: dark;
}

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body {
  margin: 0;
  font-family: var(--font);
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.7;
  color: var(--text);
  background: var(--bg);
  overflow-x: hidden;
}
body.no-scroll { overflow: hidden; }
a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
ul { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
h1, h2, h3, h4, p, dl, dd, figure, blockquote { margin: 0; }
h1, h2, h3, h4 { text-wrap: balance; }
button { font-family: inherit; cursor: pointer; border: none; color: inherit; }
:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent-text); outline-offset: 3px; }

.container {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 1000px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding-left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left, 0px));
  padding-right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
}

/* ----- ปุ่ม ----- */
.btn {
  display: inline-block;
  padding: 12px 28px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-weight: 500;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
  transition: transform var(--ease), background var(--ease), color var(--ease);
}
.btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
.btn--light { background: #fff; color: #9D0208; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2); }
.btn--light:hover { background: #ffe5e5; }

/* ===== Header + เมนูมือถือ ===== */
.header {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
  padding-top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px);
  background: var(--surface);
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1);
  z-index: 100;
}
.header__inner {
  height: var(--header-h);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}
.logo { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text); }
.logo span { color: var(--accent-text); }

.menu-toggle {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 130;
  width: 44px; height: 44px;
  background: transparent;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
}
.menu-toggle__bar {
  width: 26px; height: 3px;
  background: var(--accent-text);
  border-radius: 3px;
  transition: transform var(--ease), opacity var(--ease), background var(--ease);
}
.menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .menu-toggle__bar { background: #fff; }
.menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .menu-toggle__bar:nth-child(1) { transform: translateY(9px) rotate(45deg); }
.menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .menu-toggle__bar:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
.menu-toggle[aria-expanded="true"] .menu-toggle__bar:nth-child(3) { transform: translateY(-9px) rotate(-45deg); }

.nav {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0; right: 0;
  width: 75%;
  max-width: 320px;
  height: 100%;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--hero-a), var(--hero-b));
  padding-top: calc(env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px) + var(--header-h) + 30px);
  padding-right: calc(30px + env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
  padding-bottom: calc(30px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  padding-left: 30px;
  transform: translateX(100%);
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: transform 0.35s ease, visibility 0.35s;
  z-index: 120;
  box-shadow: -8px 0 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
  overflow-y: auto;
}
.nav.open { transform: translateX(0); visibility: visible; }
.nav__list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }
.nav__link {
  display: block;
  padding: 14px 16px;
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  border-radius: 12px;
  transition: background var(--ease);
}
.nav__link:hover, .nav__link.active { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); }

.overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transition: opacity var(--ease), visibility var(--ease);
  z-index: 110;
}
.overlay.show { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; }

/* ===== Section ทั่วไป ===== */
.section {
  padding-block: 72px;
  scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--header-h) + env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px));
  background: var(--bg);
}
.section--tint { background: var(--bg-tint); }
.section__title {
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 1.9rem;
  line-height: 1.3;
  color: var(--heading);
  margin-bottom: 40px;
}
.section__title::after {
  content: '';
  display: block;
  width: 60px; height: 4px;
  background: var(--accent);
  border-radius: 4px;
  margin: 10px auto 0;
}

.ph {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  color: var(--accent-text);
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--accent-soft), var(--accent-soft-2));
}
.icon { width: 48px; height: 48px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }

/* ===== 1. Hero ===== */
.hero {
  padding-top: calc(var(--header-h) + 56px);
  padding-bottom: 40px;
  text-align: center;
  color: #fff;
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--hero-a) 0%, var(--hero-b) 100%);
}
.hero__avatar, .profile__avatar { border-radius: 50%; overflow: hidden; }
.hero__avatar img, .profile__avatar img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
.hero__avatar {
  width: 180px; height: 180px;
  margin: 0 auto 24px;
  border: 5px solid #fff;
  box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
}
.hero__title { font-size: 2.1rem; line-height: 1.3; }
.hero__subtitle { font-size: 1.15rem; margin-top: 6px; opacity: 0.95; }
.hero__tagline { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 300; margin: 6px 0 28px; opacity: 0.9; }
.scroll-cue {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  margin-top: 36px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  opacity: 0.9;
}
.scroll-cue svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: #fff; stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; animation: bob 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes bob { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); } 50% { transform: translateY(6px); } }

/* ===== 2. ประวัติ ===== */
.profile { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 28px; align-items: start; }
.profile__avatar {
  width: 200px; height: 200px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  border: 5px solid var(--surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
.profile__cards { display: grid; gap: 20px; min-width: 0; }
.info {
  min-width: 0;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 22px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
.info h3 { color: var(--heading); font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 10px; }
.info dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: max-content 1fr; gap: 6px 16px; }
.info dt { color: var(--muted); }
.info dd { min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.motto {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 26px 22px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: linear-gradient(160deg, var(--hero-a), var(--hero-b));
  color: #fff;
}
.motto h3 { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.9; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.motto p { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 500; }

/* ===== 3. เป้าหมาย ===== */
.motivation { max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; gap: 16px; text-align: center; }
.motivation p { color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.1rem; }

/* ===== 4. การศึกษา ===== */
.edu { max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; gap: 18px; }
.edu__item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 18px;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 18px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
.edu__logo { flex: none; width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 14px; }
.edu__logo .icon { width: 34px; height: 34px; }
.edu__text { min-width: 0; }
.edu__level {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  color: var(--heading);
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 2px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
}
.edu__text h3 { font-size: 1.05rem; margin-top: 4px; }

/* ===== 5. กิจกรรม ===== */
.activities { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; max-width: 900px; margin: 0 auto; }
.act {
  min-width: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  transition: transform var(--ease), box-shadow var(--ease);
}
.act:hover { transform: translateY(-6px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); }
.act__photo { display: block; width: 100%; padding: 0; background: var(--accent-soft); aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; max-width: 100%; }
.act__photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
.act__body { padding: 20px 22px 22px; }
.act__tag {
  display: inline-block;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  padding: 2px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.act h3 { color: var(--heading); font-size: 1.1rem; }
.act p { margin-top: 6px; font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--muted); }
.act__hint { margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.8rem; }

/* ===== 6. ติดต่อ ===== */
.contact { max-width: 720px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 18px; }
.contact__item {
  min-width: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 18px 20px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
}
.contact__icon { flex: none; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); color: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
.contact__icon .icon { width: 26px; height: 26px; }
.contact__body { flex: 1 1 160px; min-width: 0; }
.contact__label { font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--muted); }
.contact__value { user-select: all; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-weight: 500; }
.copy-btn {
  padding: 4px 14px;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--accent-soft);
  color: var(--heading);
  transition: background var(--ease), color var(--ease);
}
.copy-btn:hover { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
.contact__item a.copy-btn { display: inline-block; }

/* ===== Footer + ปุ่มกลับขึ้นบน ===== */
.footer {
  background: var(--hero-b);
  color: #fff;
  text-align: center;
  padding-block: 32px;
}
.footer h2 { font-size: 1.5rem; }
.footer p { font-size: 0.9rem; opacity: 0.85; margin-top: 4px; }
.to-top {
  position: fixed;
  right: calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
  bottom: calc(18px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px));
  width: 46px; height: 46px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 1.3rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow);
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateY(10px);
  transition: var(--ease);
  z-index: 90;
}
.to-top.show { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transform: none; }
.to-top:hover { background: var(--accent-dark); }

/* ===== Modal ดูรูปขยาย ===== */
.modal {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  padding: 20px max(20px, env(safe-area-inset-right, 0px));
  z-index: 200;
}
.modal[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.modal__box {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 760px;
  max-height: 100%;
  overflow-y: auto;
  background: var(--surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--line);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 14px 14px 18px;
  text-align: center;
  animation: pop 0.3s ease;
}
.modal__close {
  position: absolute;
  top: 22px; right: 22px;
  width: 38px; height: 38px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--accent);
  color: #fff;
  font-size: 1rem;
  z-index: 1;
}
.modal__close:hover { background: var(--accent-dark); }
.modal__img { margin-bottom: 12px; }
.modal__img img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 12px; }
.modal__box h3 { color: var(--heading); }
@keyframes pop { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.92); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }

/* ===== fade-in ตอนเลื่อน (ส่วนที่อยู่ในจอตอนโหลดแสดงทันที) ===== */
.reveal { transition: opacity 0.7s ease, transform 0.7s ease; }
.reveal.pending { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px); }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after { transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
}

/* ===== แท็บเล็ต ===== */
@media (min-width: 600px) {
  .activities { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
  .hero__title { font-size: 2.6rem; }
}

/* ===== จอใหญ่ ===== */
@media (min-width: 900px) {
  .menu-toggle, .overlay { display: none; }
  .nav {
    position: static;
    width: auto; max-width: none; height: auto;
    padding: 0;
    background: none;
    transform: none;
    visibility: visible;
    box-shadow: none;
    overflow: visible;
  }
  .nav__list { flex-direction: row; gap: 2px; }
  .nav__link { color: var(--text); font-size: 0.95rem; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; }
  .nav__link:hover { background: var(--accent-soft); }
  .nav__link.active { background: var(--accent); color: #fff; }
  .profile { grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr; gap: 40px; }
  .profile__avatar { width: 240px; height: 240px; }
  .contact { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); max-width: none; }
  .contact__item { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; padding: 26px 20px; }
  .contact__body { flex: none; }
  .hero__avatar { width: 200px; height: 200px; }
}
</style>

<!-- ===== เมนูนำทาง ===== -->
<header class="header" id="header">
  <div class="container header__inner">
    <a href="#hero" class="logo">Field<span>Portfolio</span></a>

    <button class="menu-toggle" id="menuToggle" aria-label="เปิดเมนู" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="nav">
      <span class="menu-toggle__bar"></span>
      <span class="menu-toggle__bar"></span>
      <span class="menu-toggle__bar"></span>
    </button>

    <nav class="nav" id="nav" aria-label="เมนูหลัก">
      <ul class="nav__list">
        <li><a href="#hero" class="nav__link active">หน้าแรก</a></li>
        <li><a href="#profile" class="nav__link">ประวัติ</a></li>
        <li><a href="#motivation" class="nav__link">เป้าหมาย</a></li>
        <li><a href="#education" class="nav__link">การศึกษา</a></li>
        <li><a href="#activities" class="nav__link">กิจกรรม</a></li>
        <li><a href="#contact" class="nav__link">ติดต่อ</a></li>
      </ul>
    </nav>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="overlay" id="overlay"></div>

<main>

  <!-- ===== 1. Hero ===== -->
  <section class="hero" id="hero">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="hero__avatar">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="ธนพิพัฒน์ ในชุดนักเรียน ยกนิ้วชี้แตะริมฝีปาก">
      </div>
      <h1 class="hero__title">ธนพิพัฒน์ ธีรโชติอานันท์</h1>
      <p class="hero__subtitle">E-Portfolio · ชื่อเล่น ฟิลด์</p>
      <p class="hero__tagline">สาขาวิทยาศาสตร์การกีฬา · มหาวิทยาลัยธรรมศาสตร์</p>
      <a href="#profile" class="btn btn--light">ดูผลงาน</a>
      <div>
        <a href="#profile" class="scroll-cue" aria-label="เลื่อนลง">
          <span>เลื่อนลง</span>
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg>
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- ===== 2. ประวัติ ===== -->
  <section class="section" id="profile">
    <div class="container">
      <h2 class="section__title reveal">ประวัติส่วนตัว</h2>
      <div class="profile reveal">
        <div class="profile__avatar">
          <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="ภาพถ่ายของธนพิพัฒน์" loading="lazy">
        </div>
        <div class="profile__cards">
          <div class="info">
            <h3>ข้อมูลทั่วไป</h3>
            <dl>
              <dt>ชื่อ-นามสกุล</dt><dd>นายธนพิพัฒน์ ธีรโชติอานันท์</dd>
              <dt>ชื่อเล่น</dt><dd>ฟิลด์</dd>
              <dt>วันเกิด</dt><dd>23 พฤศจิกายน 2551</dd>
              <dt>อายุ</dt><dd>17 ปี</dd>
            </dl>
          </div>
          <div class="info">
            <h3>ที่อยู่</h3>
            <p>บ้านฟ้ารังสิต คลอง 4 ตำบลบึงยี่โถ อำเภอธัญบุรี จังหวัดปทุมธานี</p>

          <div class="contact__icon" aria-hidden="true"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 48 48"><rect x="5" y="10" width="38" height="28" rx="4"/><path d="m6 13 18 14 18-14"/></svg></div>
          <div class="contact__body"><div class="contact__label">อีเมล</div><div class="contact__value" id="emailText">tr33179@thanyarat.ac.th</div></div>

<footer class="footer">
  <div class="container">
    <h2>Thank You</h2>
    <p>© <span id="year"></span> ธนพิพัฒน์ ธีรโชติอานันท์</p>
  </div>
</footer>

<button class="to-top" id="toTop" aria-label="เลื่อนกลับขึ้นบน">↑</button>

<div class="modal" id="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="modalTitle" hidden>
  <div class="modal__box">
    <button class="modal__close" id="modalClose" aria-label="ปิดหน้าต่าง">✕</button>
    <div class="modal__img" id="modalImg"></div>
    <h3 id="modalTitle"></h3>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {

  var menuToggle = document.getElementById('menuToggle');
  var nav = document.getElementById('nav');
  var overlay = document.getElementById('overlay');
  var navLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.nav__link');
  var sections = document.querySelectorAll('main section[id]');
  var modal = document.getElementById('modal');

  /* ===== 1) เปิด/ปิดเมนูมือถือ ===== */
  function openMenu() {
    nav.classList.add('open');
    overlay.classList.add('show');
    menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-label', 'ปิดเมนู');
    document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
  }
  function closeMenu() {
    nav.classList.remove('open');
    overlay.classList.remove('show');
    menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-label', 'เปิดเมนู');
    if (modal.hidden) document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
  }
  menuToggle.addEventListener('click', function () {
    nav.classList.contains('open') ? closeMenu() : openMenu();
  });
  overlay.addEventListener('click', closeMenu);
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { closeMenu(); closeModal(); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
    if (window.innerWidth >= 900) closeMenu();
  });

  /* ===== 2) เลื่อนนุ่มนวล + ปิดเมนู ===== */
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function (link) {
    link.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var target = document.querySelector(link.getAttribute('href'));
      if (!target) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      closeMenu();
      target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    });
  });

  /* ===== 3) ไฮไลต์เมนูตามส่วนที่กำลังดู ===== */
  var spy = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
    entries.forEach(function (entry) {
      if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
      navLinks.forEach(function (link) {
        link.classList.toggle('active', link.getAttribute('href') === '#' + entry.target.id);
      });
    });
  }, { rootMargin: '-45% 0px -50% 0px' });
  sections.forEach(function (sec) { spy.observe(sec); });

  /* ===== 4) fade-in ตอนเลื่อน ===== */
  var revealObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries, obs) {
    entries.forEach(function (entry) {
      if (!entry.isIntersecting) return;
      entry.target.classList.remove('pending');
      obs.unobserve(entry.target);
    });
  }, { threshold: 0.12 });
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function (el) {
    if (el.getBoundingClientRect().top > window.innerHeight) {
      el.classList.add('pending');
      revealObserver.observe(el);
    }
  });

  /* ===== 5) กดรูปกิจกรรมเพื่อดูภาพขยาย ===== */
  var modalClose = document.getElementById('modalClose');
  var modalImg = document.getElementById('modalImg');
  var modalTitle = document.getElementById('modalTitle');
  var lastFocused = null;

  function openModal(card) {
    var img = card.querySelector('img').cloneNode(false);
    img.removeAttribute('loading');
    modalImg.innerHTML = '';
    modalImg.appendChild(img);
    modalTitle.textContent = card.querySelector('h3').textContent;
    lastFocused = document.activeElement;
    modal.hidden = false;
    document.body.classList.add('no-scroll');
    modalClose.focus();
  }
  function closeModal() {
    if (modal.hidden) return;
    modal.hidden = true;
    if (!nav.classList.contains('open')) document.body.classList.remove('no-scroll');
    if (lastFocused) lastFocused.focus();
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.act__photo').forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () { openModal(btn.closest('.act')); });
  });
  modalClose.addEventListener('click', closeModal);
  modal.addEventListener('click', function (e) { if (e.target === modal) closeModal(); });

  /* ===== 6) ปุ่มคัดลอกเบอร์โทร/อีเมล ===== */
  document.querySelectorAll('button.copy-btn').forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var el = document.getElementById(btn.dataset.copy);
      function selectFallback() {
        var range = document.createRange();
        range.selectNodeContents(el);
        var sel = window.getSelection();
        sel.removeAllRanges();
        sel.addRange(range);
        btn.textContent = 'เลือกข้อความแล้ว';
      }
      try {
        navigator.clipboard.writeText(el.textContent).then(function () {
          btn.textContent = 'คัดลอกแล้ว';
        }, selectFallback);
      } catch (err) { selectFallback(); }
      setTimeout(function () { btn.textContent = 'คัดลอก'; }, 2000);
    });
  });

  /* ===== 7) ปุ่มกลับขึ้นบน + ปีใน Footer ===== */
  var toTop = document.getElementById('toTop');
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function () {
    toTop.classList.toggle('show', window.scrollY > 400);
  }, { passive: true });
  toTop.addEventListener('click', function () {
    window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: 'smooth' });
  });
  document.getElementById('year').textContent = new Date().getFullYear() + 543;
});
</script>

</body></html>
